kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تضاعفت (form VI)
# تَضَاعَفْتُ (taḍāʕaftu) /ta.dˤaː.ʕaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# تَضَاعَفْتَ (taḍāʕafta) /ta.dˤaː.ʕaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# تَضَاعَفْتِ (taḍāʕafti) /ta.dˤaː.ʕaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# تَضَاعَفَتْ (taḍāʕafat) /ta.dˤaː.ʕa.fat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
